performance_authorities.build_profile_requirements: CMake or the repository's build recipe, release build, assembly enabled for the target, OpenSSL-compatible libcrypto ABI, provider/engine configuration recorded
performance_authorities.api_surface: OpenSSL-compatible libcrypto C ABI (usable by bench_api.c with the same dlopen/dlsym discipline)
performance_authorities.reason: No AWS-LC source archive, installed library, header tree or offline cargo source exists in this environment. The court's ldconfig, pkg-config, /usr and /usr/local searches and /usr/local/cargo registry search returned no AWS-LC artefact.
performance_authorities.acquisition_path: Pin an aws/aws-lc commit in forensics/authorities/AUTHORITIES.json, fetch the source into forensics/authorities/src, build a release libcrypto in the court with the recorded CMake flags, and benchmark the resulting DSO with the same harness. Network access or a tracked source archive is a prerequisite; neither is available here.

performance_authorities.build_profile_requirements: CMake/Ninja release build, assembly enabled, the commit recorded; BoringSSL does not promise a stable ABI, so the adapter symbol set must be checked against the harness
performance_authorities.api_surface: C library with OpenSSL-derived libcrypto symbols; the harness symbol set must be verified for the pinned commit
performance_authorities.reason: No BoringSSL source or built library exists in this environment; no offline cargo source is present.

performance_authorities.build_profile_requirements: A pinned rustls version and a named crypto provider (for example aws-lc-rs or ring), with the provider version and feature set recorded as part of the identity
performance_authorities.api_surface: Rust API only; rustls does not expose an OpenSSL C ABI
performance_authorities.reason: No rustls, aws-lc-rs or ring source exists in the offline cargo registry in this environment, and rustls exposes no OpenSSL C ABI, so bench_api.c cannot host it even if the source were present.
performance_authorities.acquisition_path: Pin rustls and its provider crate, add a separate Rust benchmark harness that calls the same primitive shapes, and record the provider as part of the identity. This is a different harness from the C-API court and cannot be merged into the current rows without a recorded instrument difference.

performance_authorities.build_profile_requirements: Release build with the OpenSSL compatibility layer enabled (for example --enable-opensslextra), assembly enabled, the exact configure line recorded

performance_authorities.build_profile_requirements: A specific kernel (for example s2n-bignum or fiat-crypto output) plus a small driver that exposes the same operation; the kernel identity and build flags are part of the identity
performance_authorities.api_surface: Kernel-level API, not a complete OpenSSL-compatible libcrypto

performance_authorities.acquisition_path: Select and pin a kernel, build it for the target, write a driver for the exact operation, and record it as a separate research-frontier row with its own instrument; it is not a drop-in OpenSSL comparator.
